entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, your company sold me a torture device disguised as a pair of cycling shoes. This is absolutely unacceptable!
I'm very sorry to hear you're having a bad experience. Can I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Mike Peterson, order number 8675309. And don't give me the runaround. I wore these things on one ride and they gave me the worst blisters I've ever had. I want a full refund, now!

Okay, Mike, I've got your order right here. I see you purchased the Road Cycling Shoes. I'm sorry about the blisters. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a sizing problem or a technical fault with the shoe itself?

Are you listening to me?! I said they're garbage and they hurt my feet! I'm not here for a 20-questions diagnosis. I'm a paying customer and I want my money back. Get me your manager if you can't handle this simple request!
No, that won't be necessary, sir. I can certainly help you with this. I just need to confirm a few details. Let me quickly review our return policy for you.
There's nothing to review! I'm telling you, I will light up every social media platform and review site with photos of these blisters if I don't get a refund on this call.
I understand your frustration, Mike. Please give me just one moment. Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase was 19 days ago, and our standard return policy is 90 days. You are well within the window.
See? Was that so hard? So you're processing it then?

Yes, absolutely. I am processing the return authorization right now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Please package the cycling shoes, along with the cleats they came with, and drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the return, you'll receive a full refund to your original payment method.
Fine. That's what you should have done in the first place. Send the label.
It's already sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
